definitions.explanation: The practice of reducing energy consumption and using energy more efficiently. Shortened from {省|しょう}エネルギー.

examples.japanese: {省|しょう}エネ{家電|かでん}を{選|えら}ぶようにしている。
examples.english: I try to choose energy-efficient appliances.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{省|しょう}エネのため{冷房|れいぼう}を28{度|ど}に{設定|せってい}する。
examples.english: In summer, I set the AC to 28 degrees to save energy.

examples.japanese: {省|しょう}エネ{意識|いしき}が{高|たか}まっている。
この{ビル}は{省|しょう}エネ{設計|せっけい}になっている。
examples.english: This building has an energy-efficient design.

notes:
ABBREVIATION:
{省|しょう}エネ is short for {省|しょう}エネルギー (energy saving/conservation).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {省|しょう}エネ{家電|かでん}: Energy-efficient appliances
- {省|しょう}エネ{住宅|じゅうたく}: Energy-efficient housing
- {省|しょう}エネ{対策|たいさく}: Energy-saving measures
- {省|しょう}エネ{モード}: Energy-saving mode
- {省|しょう}エネ{設計|せっけい}: Energy-efficient design

JAPAN'S ENERGY CONSERVATION:
Japan has promoted {省|しょう}エネ since the oil crises of the 1970s. Notable campaigns include:
- クールビズ: Cool Biz (summer business casual to reduce AC use)
- ウォームビズ: Warm Biz (winter layering to reduce heating)
- {節電|せつでん}: Power saving (especially after 2011 earthquake)

RELATED TERMS:
- {節電|せつでん}: Power saving
- {節水|せっすい}: Water conservation
- {再生可能|さいせいかのう}エネルギー: Renewable energy
- エコ: Eco-friendly
- SDGs (エスディージーズ): Sustainable Development Goals

NOTE: Japan has some of the world's most stringent {省|しょう}エネ standards for appliances, with mandatory energy efficiency labeling.
